cards.card_text: The elder calls him beloved and says he loves him in the truth.
cards.verse_text: The elder, To the beloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth:
cards.snippet: The elder, To the beloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth:

cards.card_text: Then Jude turns back to his readers, the beloved, and tells them to remember what the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ foretold.
cards.verse_text: But you, beloved, remember what was foretold by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ
cards.snippet: But you, beloved, remember what was foretold by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ

cards.card_text: But Jude hands the beloved a recipe: build yourselves up in your most holy faith, and pray in the Holy Spirit.
cards.verse_text: But you, beloved, by building yourselves up in your most holy faith and praying in the Holy Spirit,

cards.card_text: That army marches across the broad expanse of the earth and surrounds the camp of the saints and the beloved city.
